lessons.author: Paul Graham
lessons.quote: Without visual cues (e.g. the horizon) you can't distinguish between gravity and acceleration. Which means if you're flying through clouds you can't tell what the attitude of the aircraft is. You could feel like you're flying straight and level while in fact you're descending in a spiral. The solution is to ignore what your body is telling you and listen only to your instruments. But it turns out to be very hard to ignore what your body is telling you. Every pilot knows about this [problem](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spatial_disorientation) and yet it is still a leading cause of accidents.

lessons.author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
lessons.quote: If you know, in the morning, what your day looks like with any precision, you are a little bit dead—the more precision, the more dead you are.

lessons.author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
lessons.quote: He did not make his billions by cost benefit analysis, rather, simply by establishing a high filter, then picking opportunities that pass such threshold. “The difference between successful people and really successful people is that really successful people *say no* to almost everything.”

lessons.author: Frank Herbert
lessons.quote: A leader, you see, is one of the things that distinguishes a mob from a people. He maintains the level of individuals. Too few individuals, and a people reverts to a mob.

lessons.author: Walter Isaacson
lessons.quote: Delete any part or process you can. You may have to add them back later. In fact, if you do not end up adding back at least 10% of them, then you didn’t delete enough.
